package firmwaremanifest

import (
 "encoding/json"
 "errors"
 "fmt"
 "os"
 "testing"
)

func TestCaptureOldGo(t *testing.T) {
 contents, err := os.ReadFile("cases.json")
 if err != nil { panic(err) }
 var cases []struct { Name, Input string }
 if err := json.Unmarshal(contents, &cases); err != nil { panic(err) }
 results := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(cases))
 for _, test := range cases {
  catalogJSON = []byte(test.Input)
  value, err := Load()
  encoded, marshalErr := json.Marshal(value)
  if marshalErr != nil { panic(marshalErr) }
  message, kind := "", ""
  if err != nil { message, kind = err.Error(), fmt.Sprintf("%T", err) }
  results = append(results, map[string]any{
   "name":test.Name, "input":test.Input, "json":string(encoded),
   "error":message, "errorType":kind, "invalid":errors.Is(err, ErrInvalid),
  })
 }
 output, err := os.Create("captured.json")
 if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 defer func() { if err := output.Close(); err != nil { t.Error(err) } }()
 encoder := json.NewEncoder(output)
 encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
 if err := encoder.Encode(results); err != nil { panic(err) }
}
